build_secstruct_layer: build a tensorflow secstruct layer that computes Q8 and Q3 secondary structure probabilities from activations
create_q3_matrices: create the Q8 to Q3 mapping matrix and lookup array for secondary structure equivalence classes
save_secstructs_file: save secondary structure probability distributions to an ss2 file with residue labels and probabilities
get_q8_probs: get the Q8 secondary structure softmax probabilities from a Secstruct layer instance
review_secstruct_class: review the Secstruct class that models hierarchical secondary structure with Q8 and Q3 probability outputs
